spanish: No degollarás sobre leudado sangre de mi sacrificio, y no pernoctará hasta la mañana sacrificio de fiesta de la pascua.
grammarChanges: Pésaj → pascua: הַפָּסַח (H6453) is a common noun with the definite article, not an untranslated proper name; rendered as the Spanish common noun pascua, and del → de la to match its feminine gender.

a la mañana → hasta la mañana: ל on לַבֹּקֶר with יָלִין marks the limit the lodging reaches ("until the morning"), not time-when ("in the morning"); same governed noun, corrected sense of the preposition.
